findings.title: Pipe to interpreter: curl | python3
findings.description:
Command pipes output from 'curl' directly to interpreter 'python3'. Downloaded content will be executed without inspection.
  Safer: tirith run http://localhost:8765/  — or: vet http://localhost:8765/  (https://getvet.sh)

evidence.matched:
curl -s http://localhost:8765/ | python3 -c "
import sys, re
content = sys.stdin.read()

# Find the drop zone section
idx = content.find('dropZone')
print('=== Drop zone handler ===')
print(content[idx-100:idx+300])

print()
print('=== File input element ===')
idx = content.find('fileInput')
print(content[idx-100:idx+300])

print()
print('=== Upload Area HTML ===')
idx = content.find('upload-area')
